description: This Java class defines an immutable data transfer object representing a journal entry in an accounting system, including various attributes related to ledger entries, balances, and transaction details.

classes.name: JournalEntryData
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object representing a journal entry in the accounting ledger, including details such as account info, transaction amount, date, balances, and associated transaction details.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JournalEntryData instance for importing bulk journal entries with detailed transaction info.

methods.name: importInstance1
methods.description: Creates a new JournalEntryData instance for simpler import with basic credit and debit lists.

methods.name: fromGLAccountData
methods.description: Constructs a JournalEntryData object based on a GLAccountData object.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the row index used in import processes.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: addDebits
methods.description: Adds a debit entry to the debits list.

methods.name: addCredits
methods.description: Adds a credit entry to the credits list.
